czech: Kdybych věděl o problému, pomohl bych
english: If I knew about the problem, I'd help

czech: Kdybys měl více zkušeností, zvládl bys to
english: If you had more experience, you'd manage it

czech: Kdyby byl doma, otevřel by dveře
english: If he were at home, he'd open the door

czech: Kdyby měla auto, jezdila by do práce
english: If she had a car, she'd drive to work

czech: Kdyby to bylo levnější, koupili bychom to
english: If it were cheaper, we'd buy it

czech: Kdybychom znali adresu, našli bychom ho
english: If we knew the address, we'd find him

czech: Kdybyste se zeptali dříve, dostali byste odpověď
english: If you asked earlier, you'd get an answer

czech: Kdyby měli více informací, rozhodli by se jinak
english: If they had more information, they'd decide differently
